editorial.marketOverview: Sunday 03:07 EST: US cash markets remain closed. Friday's severe Nasdaq and semiconductor drawdown, extreme VIX and weak breadth still frame a bearish November 23–25 outlook. Weekend market previews recap the same risk-off regime; they are not fresh cash-market observations. Reported QQQ/SOX/Nasdaq and volatility readings are Friday historical levels.
editorial.whatChanged: Compared with the 02:17 EST snapshot, no verified directional shift or new curated Open Watch event. November 22 weekly recaps and earnings previews reinforce known AI valuation, Nvidia scrutiny and holiday-week macro risks. No Sunday US cash-market response is possible.
editorial.marketInterpretation: Semiconductor relative weakness versus Nasdaq and poor breadth suggest concentration-led de-risking rather than a confirmed isolated dip. Extreme volatility may generate violent relief rallies, but a durable reversal needs synchronized chip/QQQ leadership, improving breadth and easing volatility. Friday yields and oil are stale; no Fed probability is invented.
editorial.threeDayPath: Monday November 23: flash PMI and reopening of NVDA/SOX/QQQ determine whether forced selling continues or an oversold bounce begins. Tuesday November 24: consumer confidence and ADI/DELL earnings can test hardware demand narratives. Wednesday November 25: PCE/GDP/durable goods and Beige Book can reprice rates and growth, with Thanksgiving-week liquidity amplifying swings. All outcomes are prospective.
editorial.bullCase: A sharp oversold recovery becomes credible only if QQQ, SOX and SMH recover together, advancers broaden and VXN/VIX decline; lower synchronized yields would help. Taiwan selling restrictions may ease local pressure but US impact is unobserved.
editorial.bearCase: Semiconductor leadership remains impaired following Friday's approximately 11% SOX loss, with weak breadth and high VIX. Renewed NVDA regulatory headlines, firm yields or adverse macro data could extend downside; none of these future outcomes is assumed to have occurred.
editorial.watchNext: Verify Monday 09:45 ET flash PMIs and live opening QQQ/SOX/SMH breadth and VXN/VIX; retrieve matched Treasury yields, primary FedWatch and same-contract Brent/WTI. Monitor primary NVDA/SEC statements and the ADI/DELL earnings schedule. Separate release surprise from subsequent observed price response.
